# Code of Conduct

We want this project to be a welcoming, harassment-free place to work on software together.

## Expected behaviour

- Be respectful and assume good faith. Disagree with ideas, not people.
- Give and accept constructive, specific feedback.
- Respect different backgrounds, experience levels, languages and time zones.
- Keep discussions on topic and technical decisions evidence-based.

## Unacceptable behaviour

- Harassment, insults, discrimination or personal attacks of any kind.
- Publishing others' private information without consent.
- Sexualised language or attention, trolling, or sustained disruption.
- Other conduct that would reasonably be considered inappropriate in a professional setting.

## Scope and enforcement

This applies to all project spaces (issues, pull requests, discussions) and to people representing
the project in public. Maintainers may edit, hide or remove contributions and may restrict
participation of anyone who violates these standards.

Report concerns privately to the maintainers by email at **thinnd.work@gmail.com** (subject
`vue-draggable conduct`). Reports are handled confidentially.
